simulate_salt_and_pepper_noise: simulate salt and pepper noise on a numpy image array using configurable s_vs_p ratio and noise amount
create_noise_model_instance: create a SaltAndPepperNoiseModel instance with custom salt-to-pepper ratio and noise amount parameters for color sensor noise
apply_noise_to_image: apply salt and pepper noise to an image by calling the apply method on a SaltAndPepperNoiseModel instance
check_valid_sensor_type: check if a sensor type is valid for salt and pepper noise by calling is_valid_sensor_type with a SensorType enum
build_cpu_noise_impl: build a SaltAndPepperNoiseModelCPUImpl instance to directly simulate salt and pepper noise on a numpy image array
